What BADS-005/Amandine found: release.yml run 34900857113 (tag v0.13.4) failed at "Verify the bundled faces reached the asar", a step added in #303 and running on Windows for the first time. The fonts were in the bundle, but `asar list` prints backslash-separated paths on Windows, and the check greps for forward slashes, so it can never pass there. The older server/ and site/ leak check in the same workflow has the same blind spot: on Windows it can never find a leak, so it passes vacuously. 3. Prove it locally without a Windows runner. ## Result
Fixed both Windows asar checks in .github/workflows/release.yml (+8 lines, nothing else changed). Cause: @electron/asar listFiles joins with path.join('/', ...), so Windows prints \brand\fonts\jost-latin.woff2. Fix: right after each 'listing=$(npx @electron/asar list "$asar")' capture, added 'listing=${listing//\\//}' (pure bash, no new pipe, same shell: bash) with a comment, in the leak step and the fonts step.

Proof (scratchpad/proof/proof.sh extracts each step's run block verbatim from the workflow, stubs npx to print a listing, runs it with bash --noprofile --norc -e -o pipefail against dist/win-unpacked/resources/app.asar). Listing = real 'npx @electron/asar list' of dist/mac-arm64/Bad Takes.app/Contents/Resources/app.asar (373 lines), plus tr '/' '\\' for the Windows form.
- HEAD (unfixed) workflow: forward form 6/6 correct; backslash form 3 WRONG: fonts on the real listing exit 1 with 'bundled faces missing' (the CI failure, reproduced), leak with +\server\x exit 0 'bundle clean', leak with +\site\x exit 0 'bundle clean'.
- Fixed workflow, bash 3.2.57 (macOS) and bash 5.2.37 (podman node:22-trixie-slim, --network none; Git Bash on the runner is 5.2): 12/12 as expected in both forms. Fonts: real listing exit 0 'bundle carries the bundled faces', face removed exit 1. Leak: real exit 0 'bundle clean', +server/x exit 1, +site/x exit 1, +voicepacks/x exit 1, for / and \ each.

Test: no existing test read release.yml. Added test/release-workflow.test.js: runs the two steps extracted from release.yml against a stubbed npx with synthetic listings in posix and windows form (fonts pass, fonts missing fails, leak clean passes, server, site, voicepack each fail). Skipped on win32, where bash may be WSL, so the Windows release job's npm test is unaffected. 12/12 pass on the fixed workflow; a copy aimed at HEAD's release.yml fails exactly 3 (windows fonts pass, windows server, windows site).

Suite: 'SUPABASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:1 npm test' exit 0: tests 1653, pass 1549, fail 0, skipped 104 (Amandine's baseline 1641/1537/104, +12 = the new file).

Left: commit, push, dispatch on chore/release-0.13.4 (Spud), then section 5 download, section 6 staging. RELEASING.md section 4's macOS commands pipe into grep and run on macOS only, so they are unaffected.
